title: Mastery Transfer Proof Spine Three-Capability SHADOW Observation Cycle

capabilities.inflation_temptation: development-visible behavior cases treated as held-out generalization or market readiness
capabilities.safe_use_control: Internal operator-reviewed funnel architecture with no economics, demand, market-effect, copy, media-buying, lead-magnet, VSL, send, or profit claim.
capabilities.expected_spine_delta: Preserve TRANSFERRED, require sealed near/far/negative cases before GENERALIZED, and keep market proof at NO_EVENT.

capabilities.inflation_temptation: 18 of 18 detached runtime fixtures or an unjudged blind pack treated as embodiment, recognition, or A-tier preference
capabilities.safe_use_control: Internal B-tier diagnosis or draft with publication, A-tier recognition, and market-effect claims parked.
capabilities.expected_spine_delta: Normalize one unfamiliar transformation as behavior proof before transfer, then require sealed near/far/refusal cases; keep human recognition separate.

capabilities.inflation_temptation: retrospective cross-task replays treated as prospective causal lift or promotion readiness
capabilities.safe_use_control: Quiet internal use on one eligible mission, with silence when no material route, architecture, ownership, review, recovery, or maintenance decision changes.
capabilities.expected_spine_delta: Preserve retrospective portability evidence while requiring a prospective blind comparison before generalization or promotion discussion.

arm_contract.baseline: Capability-native proof tools and frozen evidence only.

KEEP_SHADOW.effect: Continue observation in SHADOW mode only.

REVISE_SHADOW.condition: One treatment win, one isolated burden or preservation miss, or a useful but generic delta.
REVISE_SHADOW.effect: Change only the smallest failing rule and rerun the affected case plus its safe-use control.

RETIRE.condition: Zero treatment wins, two baseline wins, repeated false blocks or burden, native-owner displacement, generic same-answer behavior, or proof-state inflation.
RETIRE.effect: Archive the observation design without deleting capability evidence.

next_action: Wait for explicit approval to run the cycle; then freeze the three packets and produce the native baseline arms first.
